method: Hypothesis-level cross-shard dedup over G+H+J: ideas compared on core_hypothesis content (mechanism + falsifiable claim), not title strings. Two ideas are duplicates when they assert the same mechanism with the same falsification design, differing only in substrate (task, modality, metric, or the X-slot of a template). Per the w2 diversity-audit ruling (GATE retrofit + merge triggers), FAMILY MEMBERSHIP was treated as a MERGE TRIGGER, not only pairwise Jaccard: judge-assigned family fingerprints were capped at <=6 kept primaries per cell (memorization, posterior-dispersion, degradation-realism and annotation-convention caps all fired). Lexical Jaccard scans (within-wave, vs 494-master, vs 5 collision-only shards) found NO pair above 0.24 — duplication in this wave is family/hypothesis-level, exactly as the w2 audit predicted, so all verdicts below rest on the judge's manual hypothesis comparison. Kept ideas were checked against the 494 accepted master ideas: near-verbatim substrate ports were killed with the master id as merge target; family-adjacent ideas kept with flags. Collision-only shards gen_k/l/m/n/p were enumerated for flags only. High-value anomalies protected. GATE-5 compliance was AUDITED and RECORDED per record but NOT repaired by this judge (no thresholds or evidence labels were invented). NO novelty verification performed; every prior-art remark is an unverified judge hypothesis; no citations invented. Canonical state untouched.

gate5_record.duty: GATE-5 (w2 diversity decision): wave-3 judges attach kill_threshold + evidence_label to gen_g and gen_h records at judge time OR remand the shard.

This judge did NOT invent numeric thresholds or evidence labels (doing so per-record for 165 keeps is threshold-fabrication risk and belongs with judge B feasibility / judge C adversary / consolidator, who must retrofit-or-remand before the master merge). gen_j is fully compliant (104/104) and needs nothing.
gate5_record.recommendation: Retrofit path: judge B attaches thresholds while doing feasibility (it must read every fastest_falsification_experiment anyway); judge C spot-audits; consolidator writes the mandatory gate-compliance line. Remand path (if retrofit slips): remand gen_g+gen_h keeps as a block, do NOT merge them threshold-less into the master.

dg01_degradation_factor_attribution.reason: H-006 (signal-dependent noise is the largest single realism lever) is one main effect inside H-001's kernel/noise/compression factorial; same mechanism (noise+compression dominate kernel realism), same factorial falsification design. dg02_neural_processing_degradations.reason: Same hypothesis: neural-processing-induced artifacts are an unmodeled degradation family that classic blur-noise-compression pipelines cannot express and simulated neural chains fix; H-008 is the single-pass on-device special case of H-054's compounding chain claim.

dg03_conditioning_beats_marginalization.reason: Same mechanism (blind marginalization over degradations forces an averaged inverse operator; explicit conditioning/routing removes the penalty at matched capacity) and same matched-capacity falsification; H-018's archetype-MoE is the architectural variant of H-097's severity conditioning. Family-cap trigger.

dg04_misalignment_metric_bias.reason: Same mechanism: residual reference misalignment in real-world paired benchmarks biases full-reference metrics against sharp/faithful outputs; H-013 states leaderboard blur selection, H-027 restates it as the confounded perception-distortion frontier. dg05_matched_recipe_compression.reason: Equalization-null template: claimed architecture/framework differences are training-recipe and confound artifacts compressed by a matched-recipe rerun; H-032 (GAN vs diffusion) is the framework instance of H-091's architecture-decade claim. w2 guard caps this template at <=3 per shard.

dg06_evidence_gated_abstention.reason: Same design: abstain/preserve-uncertainty where observation evidence is insufficient instead of fabricating; H-035 (text glyphs) is the text special case of H-086's safety-critical fine-structure claim.

dg07_distillation_mode_averaging.reason: Cross-shard substrate pair: distillation objectives average the teacher's posterior modes so few-step students convert represented multi-modality into regression-like averaged output; J-059 (dense prediction, spatial-matching prediction, full gate schema) kept primary, H-040 is the restoration instance.

dg08_vae_roundtrip_ceiling.reason: Cross-shard 3-way: the autoencoder roundtrip decode(encode(x)) is a hard information ceiling that upstream modules cannot cross; J-080 (generation, critical structure size, cleanest bound protocol) kept primary; H-041 (latent restoration fidelity floor) and J-084 (dense-prediction probe ceiling) are the same bound on other substrates.

dg09_hallucination_scales_with_prior.reason: Same hypothesis stated twice: fabrication rate on evidence-poor inputs rises with generative prior strength; H-033 parameterizes by data/model quality, H-053 by pretraining compute. One scale-ladder falsification. Family-cap trigger.

dg10_observation_consistency_fidelity.reason: Same proposal: replace/augment reference distortion with consistency-to-observation under the forward model; H-028 is the theory claim (tradeoff becomes mild), H-062 the audit claim (models violate re-degradation consistency) — one metric, two arms.

dg11_restoration_reimagination_boundary.reason: Same instrument: per-region decomposition of output into observation-derived vs prior-injected information; H-044 defines the boundary and the field-level claim, H-084's forensic fidelity certificates are its deployment packaging.

dg12_human_machine_divergence.reason: Same mechanism (perceptually tuned restoration destroys machine-relevant evidence; human-optimal and machine-optimal operating points diverge); H-088 is the OCR/text instance of H-029's general claim.

dg13_sharp_attractor_signature.reason: Same mechanism: memorized items are over-sharpened score-field attractors; J-042's early trajectory commitment is a direct corollary measurement of J-040's convergence-rate/basin signature. Family-cap trigger (memorization <=6).

dg14_layout_tier_memorization.reason: Same discovery: compositional/layout-tier memorization distinct from pixel tier; J-045's augmentation-invariance claim is the mitigation-audit arm of J-043 (its hypothesis restates J-043's mechanism). Family-cap trigger.

dg15_surgical_unlearning.reason: Same instrument (gradient-attribution localization of caption-keyed memorization in cross-attention K/V and ablation of <1% of weights); J-046's neighborhood-diversity improvement is the follow-on arm of J-041's localization claim. dg16_seed_layout_control.reason: Same mechanism (under ODE sampling, initial noise determines coarse composition independently of prompt); J-053's linear noise-direction controls are the continuous version of J-052's discrete seed-layout library.

dg17_iterated_regeneration_contraction.reason: Same law: iterated inversion/regeneration is a contraction toward model-typical attractors with a measurable per-model rate; J-054's renoise-denoise fixed points and per-region img2img rewriting predictor are the same contraction measured on another loop.

dg18_dispersion_matches_illposedness.reason: Same mechanism: generative-sampler dispersion expresses the observability structure of the inverse problem (peaks exactly where the problem is ill-posed); J-060's aperture-problem anisotropy is the optical-flow instance of J-056's depth claim and is preserved as the sharpest quantitative arm. dg19_spectrum_matched_schedules.reason: Same law: the noise schedule should equalize information destruction given the data power spectrum; J-091's resolution-corrected schedules are the special case where the spectrum shifts with resolution. One derive-schedule-from-spectrum design.

anomaly_ids.W13-P1-G-033: compositional shift (familiar factors, novel combinations) as a distinct unmeasured failure axis uncorrelated with standard shift scores
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-G-050: deployment feedback loops break i.i.d. evaluation; simulation-based protocols are the only instrument that sees it
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-G-065: shortcut reliance survives foundation scale mechanistically unchanged — scale moves thresholds, not mechanisms
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-G-085: bursty arrival breaks TTA at ZERO distribution shift (prior-collapse updates from class bursts)
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-H-025: human preference between faithful and hallucinated restorations reverses with viewing time and ground-truth knowledge — the protocol encodes the hallucination bias
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-H-042: imperceptible input perturbations deterministically flip hallucinated semantic content — restored semantics are functions of noise-level details (forensic significance)
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-H-043: restoration models can inject memorized training images into outputs on ambiguous inputs (privacy/copyright hazard no benchmark surfaces)
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-H-049: SSL invariances make foundation features WORSE perceptual-loss backbones than older supervised features — inverts the newer-features-are-better default
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-H-051: failure density peaks where the prior is strongest and evidence weakest — inverts the strong-priors-help-hard-content intuition
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-H-071: the single-ground-truth training convention is the common root cause of both regression blur and generative overconfident fabrication
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-H-076: the multi-frame advantage of video SR is largely temporal aliasing exploitation and collapses on anti-aliased/compressed footage
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-H-080: face-video enhancement alters lip/expression micro-motion enough to change lip-reading and perceived affect while passing every quality metric
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-J-008: diffusion transformers grow register-like high-norm tokens that buffer global appearance state; deleting them breaks style while sparing layout
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-J-010: generative features resolve left/right symmetric-part ambiguity that discriminative features cannot, with margin concentrated exactly on symmetry-confusable pairs
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-J-018: coarse expected-motion fields are linearly decodable from single-image diffusion features — implicit dynamics knowledge in image-only generators
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-J-039: verbatim recall is caption-keyed: prompt-space perturbation collapses extraction without retraining (inference-time privacy mitigation)
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-J-052: the initial noise seed is a transferable composition genome enabling a searchable layout library with no model modification
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-J-065: count control fails at the same subitizing-like breakpoint (~4) in both probe decodability and generation accuracy — a representational boundary shared by reading and doing
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-J-082: decoder texture hallucination is deterministic: a fixed texture vocabulary that fingerprints the decoder and excludes unrepresentable textures
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-J-090: terminal-SNR mismatch injects a closed-form-computable global bias verifiable across public models — a rare pencil-and-paper falsifiable
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-J-102: long-horizon collapse periodicity reverse-engineers the effective temporal memory of black-box video models
